import numpy as np
import math

def route_distance(route, dm):
    return sum(dm[route[i], route[i+1]] for i in range(len(route)-1))

                    best_pair = (i, j)

            del routes[i]

            del routes[i]
            del routes[j]

    dists = [route_distance(r, distance_matrix) for r in routes]

    def local_search(routes, max_iter, temperature):
